Lenovo Legion 5 15IRX10 (83LY00R8ED) — Intel Core i7-13650HX | RTX 5070 8GB | 32GB DDR5 | 1TB SSD

Dominate every game with serious power in a 15.3" gaming powerhouse.

The Lenovo Legion 5 15IRX10 (83LY00R8ED) pairs a 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13650HX processor with NVIDIA's GeForce RTX 5070 graphics card, giving you the muscle for high-FPS gaming, streaming, and creative workloads — all wrapped in Legion's signature durable, performance-first chassis.

Key Specifications

ComponentDetails
ModelLenovo Legion 5 15IRX10 — 83LY00R8ED
ProcessorIntel Core i7-13650HX (13th Gen)
GraphicsNVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070, 8GB dedicated VRAM
Memory32GB DDR5 RAM
Storage1TB SSD
Display15.3" IPS, 165Hz refresh rate
Operating SystemDOS (no OS pre-installed)
Warranty2 Years

Why You'll Love It

Powerful Performance, Ready for Anything The Intel Core i7-13650HX delivers strong multi-core performance for gaming, multitasking, and demanding applications, so frame drops and lag stay out of your way.

Next-Level Graphics The NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 with 8GB of dedicated VRAM brings smooth, high-detail gameplay, real-time ray tracing, and AI-accelerated rendering — perfect for the latest AAA titles and creative software alike.

Smooth, Fast Visuals A 15.3" IPS display with a 165Hz refresh rate keeps fast-paced action fluid and responsive, with the wide color accuracy IPS panels are known for.

Multitask Without Limits 32GB of DDR5 memory ensures effortless multitasking — run your game, voice chat, and stream overlay simultaneously without a hitch.

Fast, Spacious Storage A 1TB SSD gives you quick boot times, fast load screens, and plenty of room for your full game library, projects, and media.

Built to Last Backed by a 2-year warranty, so you can game and create with confidence.

Ideal For

  • Competitive and AAA gaming at high refresh rates
  • Streaming and content creation
  • Multitasking-heavy workflows
  • Gamers who want a reliable, upgrade-ready machine

Note: This unit ships with DOS (no operating system pre-installed). An OS such as Windows will need to be installed separately.
